artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Dossier-refresh driver: refresh_one, run_names, main. Builds each dossier in memory, applies the allowed-moves rule and the model-block guard, writes add-only through dossier.write_one only with --write. Default is a dry run. No schedule, no trigger, no S3 write in this cell.

20 offline arms with fake deps: the allowed-moves rule, the guard arms, UNCHANGED and NO_NEW, ERROR isolation, the flushed manifest, the trading-day gate, the two mutants, the census line shape, and a source check that no put or delete call exists.

Dry-run output over the 95 names, merged from five 20-name slices. Read-only over the real bucket: every name read, no write_one call. Final census line: names=95 written=0 would_write=93 unchanged=1 skipped_guard=1 errors=0 mode=dry-run.
Merges the five slice outputs into refresh_run_dry.out. Recomputes the census line from the merged REFRESH lines, refuses a duplicate name.
Five rows AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S1 to S5 appended by bytes (105 insertions, 0 deletions). The surprise-row gate read the new rows and passed.

mutant.description: Two mutants, each a monkeypatch inside the offline tests. Arm 8 replaces guard_decision with an always-PASS guard; arm 3's READ_FAILED stop must then NOT read SKIPPED_GUARD. Arm 9 replaces allowed_moves with an always-allowed check; arm 2's thesis_summary move must then NOT read SKIPPED_ALLOWED.
mutant.expected: both mutant arms assert that the stop or skip does not occur under the mutant (the arm expectation fails under the mutant)
mutant.observed: arm 8 under always-PASS guard: READ_FAILED case status WRITTEN, write_one called once; arm 9 under disabled allowed check: thesis_summary case status WRITTEN, write_one called once; 20 passed

determinism.method: the offline test file run twice with the same input, comparing the summary line
determinism.observed: 20 passed in 1.11s and 20 passed in 1.10s; the dry-run output is not compared for determinism because the real bucket is live (the census line is a measurement at a time, not a function of the input)

declared_exclusions.item: Any --write run, any write_one or gold_put call against the real bucket
declared_exclusions.reason: Out of this cell by the order (HVST-cn-3 is the deliberate run); the dry run is the default mode and wrote 0.

declared_exclusions.item: Scheduling, triggering or any listener for the refresh
declared_exclusions.reason: Out of this cell (HVST-cn-4 is the schedule); the driver has no loop, watcher or trigger.

declared_exclusions.item: Edits to dossier.py, gold.py, the gateway, sector_template.py or any file outside <paths>
declared_exclusions.reason: The order's write grant is the driver, its test, the deliverables folder and the channel; the KPI-census file was supplied to the worktree by the issuer and is not edited.

declared_exclusions.item: A live gateway call, any Bloomberg or model call
declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden by the order's preflight; the dry run uses only the bucket's read operations through a read-only client.

declared_exclusions.item: refresh_merge_dry.py: the merge helper that joins the five slice outputs into refresh_run_dry.out (no criterion of its own)
declared_exclusions.reason: A deterministic joiner, not a criterion-bearing artifact: AC2 reads the joined file it wrote, and the census line it prints is recomputed from the merged REFRESH lines, never copied from a slice.
The order says the issuer flips its status; this worker did not edit the order file.

surprises: AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S1: HVST-cn-1 premise: the worktree's sparse checkout omitted org/tier1_exec/, so every dossier build raised FileNotFoundError on the KPI-census file (first dry run errors=95); the issuer added the folder and the re-run measured errors=0.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S2: HVST-cn-1 status gap: no order status for a name with no stored dossier; the driver reports SKIPPED_ALLOWED with reason no-stored-dossier. No such name in the 95-name run.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S3: HVST-cn-1 status precedence: the order does not rank NO_NEW_MODEL_BLOCK against an allowed fund_form move; the driver ranks NO_NEW first. No NO_NEW row in the measured run.
AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S4: HVST-cn-1 trading-day gate: the order names no zone; --require-trading-day reads the UTC date. Not exercised by the dry run.

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W179-S5: HVST-cn-1 dry-run finding: BP_LN_Equity is WOULD_WRITE (guard PASS, model_rows moved), not NO_NEW_MODEL_BLOCK or UNCHANGED as the order expected, because a newer model block landed after the census.
